newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse to drop Suez from CAC 40 index - SBF.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse to drop Suez from CAC 40 index - SBF.

text.p: The Conseil Scientifique des Indices plans to drop Cie de Suez from calculations of the CAC-40, SBF 120 and SBF 250 indexes because of the company's plan to merge with Lyonnaise des Eaux, the SBF bourse authority said on Tuesday.

"In view of the merger of Lyonnaise des Eaux/Suez that will be submitted (for approval) to extraordinary shareholders' meetings on June 19 and June 11 respectively, the Conseil Scientifique des Indices has decided to withdraw the Suez shares from the CAC 40, SBF 120, and SBF 250," the SFB statement said.
The shares will be withdrawn on June 30, it said.
The Conseil Scientique des Indices also decided to include SGS-Thomson in the calculation of the SBF 120 and SBF 250 indexes and those of Adecco in the SBF 120.
